content:
We're back this week to update everyone on the latest offerings from Apple's official certified refurbished store. This week's highlights include the MacBook Neo, new MacBook Air configurations, the Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.

The Apple Certified Refurbished store is a great way to save money, allowing you to buy directly from Apple's official website while saving up to 15%.

Here's what you need to know:

  • Quality guaranteed, attractive prices
  • Undergoes a rigorous refurbishment process before being sold
  • Comes with Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Comes with Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare service can be purchased additionally
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not available for refurbished products

We track every addition and removal of products from the Apple Certified Refurbished store so you don't have to search for them yourself. Inventory changes quickly, and the purpose of this article is to let you know what's in stock so you can get what you want before it sells out.

Mac computers

Among them, the MacBook Neo and MacBook Air remain my top recommended bargains. Whether you're looking to join the Apple ecosystem for the first time or upgrade to a product with Apple silicon, both are excellent choices.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo with 256GB storage: $599 (originally $699 new)
  • MacBook Neo with 512GB storage and Touch ID: $679 (originally $799 new)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,099 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 1TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,529 (originally $1,799 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 2TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,949 (originally $2,299 new)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 256GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,269 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,439 (originally $1,699 new)

Studio Display

A few weeks ago, we first reported that the Studio Display XDR was available through the Apple Refurbished store. As always, I should remind everyone that inventory can change quickly, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations are still in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR with standard glass and tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $2,799 (originally $3,299 new)
  • Studio Display XDR with nano-texture glass and tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $3,059 (originally $3,599 new)

Apple TV 4K

The always-popular base model Apple TV 4K is back in stock this week, along with the ever-available high-end model with Ethernet connectivity. The base model usually sells out quickly, so don't hesitate if you want to buy one.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 64GB storage, Wi-Fi: $169 (originally $199 new)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 128GB storage, Wi-Fi + Ethernet: $209 (originally $249 new)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear the Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day. If you're thinking of getting one, the Apple Refurbished store has some good deals this week:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm black titanium case with black Ocean Band: $679 (originally $799 new)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm natural titanium case with anchor blue Ocean Band: $679 (originally $799 new)

As always, you can visit the 9to5Toys website to stay updated on the latest Apple deals throughout the week.
